limitations_and_next_input: No model density estimator is supplied by this change; a future model implementation must publish and hash a versioned model_* density estimator or density dataset before any native-volume model canary.
The adapter is an interface/causality candidate only. It does not modify frozen v1/v2/v3 runners, old results, support gates, or qualification status.
The six tests use a small analytic cloud; they do not establish real CFD material reliability or T2.
scope: material-side backend interface only; no GPU, CFD launch, ledger, or T2 decision

causality.model_input: one current State plus explicit density_estimate for that same State
